basics.name: Melody Yiyuan Zhang
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Chemical Engineering and Scientific Computing
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at the University of Michigan developing physics-informed machine-learned interaction models for the design and discovery of novel nanomaterials.

work.name: Lindsey Group & Glotzer Group, University of Michigan
highlights: Extended the machine-learned interaction model (ML-IAM), ChIMES, to describe effective interactions between polymer-grafted nanoparticles depending on key physicochemical attributes, integrated with digital alchemy inverse design.
Designed a generalized ML-IAM framework that models anisotropic interactions for nanoparticles with convex shapes.
Developed an adaptive parallel meshing algorithm for training data generation that reduces required data volume by ~100x.
Contributed to development of ChIMES, HOOMD-Blue, and Freud software.

work.name: Dou Group, Purdue University
highlights: Modified perovskite surfaces using synthesized ligands to passivate defects and kinetically trap the photovoltaic crystal phase.
Incorporated amine-thiol chemistry in perovskite layer, achieving 20.1% power conversion efficiency with improved stability.
Streamlined data analysis of photovoltaic device characteristics and performance.

work.name: University of Michigan
work.position: Graduate Student Instructor, Mathematical Analysis for Chemical Engineers
highlights: Developed and presented homework solutions and lectures with strong evaluations.
Provided support through office hours and oversaw exam administration.

work.name: AstraZeneca
highlights: Compiled annual product quality report on two active pharmaceutical ingredients using BIOVIA Discoverant.
Designed an application using Tulip for intuitive equipment and process risk assessment instructions.
